an7.27:1.1: satta vo bhikkhave aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi
an7.27:1.3: katame ca bhikkhave satta aparihāniyā dhammā
an7.27:1.4: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave bhikkhū aniccasaññaṃ bhāvessanti vuḍḍhiyeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni.
an7.27:3.1: vuḍḍhiyeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. yāvakīvañca bhikkhave ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandississanti vuḍḍhiyeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihānīti.
